records.text: Dan Flood lives in New Braunfels, Texas, and attended middle and high school in Allen, Texas.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Dan Flood also lives in New Braunfels, Texas. I can confirm that. That's a fact. The question is why? What or who inspired Dan, who is from Allen, Texas, to move out to New Braunfels? That's where he graduated high school, by the way, in Allen, Texas. We know that for a fact because one of his high school buddies after the assassination posted this.

verification.notes: Transcript context shows Owens asserting residence and school-history details based partly on an unidentified friend's post. Live searches did not find reliable public records confirming both New Braunfels residence and attendance at Allen middle and high schools; private residential and school details were not inferred from people-search sites.
